slides.title: When to Use Flexbox vs Grid 🤔
slides.content:
# Choose the Right Tool

- **Flexbox**: one‑dimensional (row **or** column). Perfect for navigation bars, centring, equal‑height cards in a row, distributing space.
- **Grid**: two‑dimensional (rows **and** columns simultaneously). Best for page layouts, dashboards, complex card grids.

They complement each other. Use Grid for the macro layout (header, main, sidebar, footer) and Flexbox for micro layouts (nav links, button groups).

## Nest Layouts

Don't try to solve everything with one grid. Nest grids or flex containers: a grid item can itself be a flex container. This modular approach keeps code maintainable.
